analysis.summary: Rajputana Biodiesel Limited reported its financial results for FY26, achieving a consolidated revenue from operations of INR 12,202.92 Lakhs and a profit after tax of INR 1,051.91 Lakhs. The company currently operates two biodiesel manufacturing facilities with an aggregate capacity of 170 KLPD and has secured government approval for two CBG units in Rajasthan. To strengthen its supply chain, the company acquired Nirvaanraj Energy Private Limited and incorporated Rajputana Agro LLP for dedicated energy crop plantations. Management highlighted its strategic vision to become an integrated bioenergy player while noting headwinds like high working capital and slow receivable cycles. Management reported strong H1 FY26 performance with robust revenue and margin expansion, supported by capacity enhancements at Phulera and Meerut units.

guidance.claim: The company aims to produce 130 to 150 kilolitres per day from the coming financial year.
guidance.quote: From April onwards, from coming April onwards, our bids in the OMC tender would be as per our enhanced capacity and we are aiming to produce 130 to 150 kilolitres per day from the coming financial year.

guidance.claim: Management stated that H2 numbers will be heavier than H1 numbers.
guidance.quote: Our H2 numbers will be heavier than H1 numbers.

guidance.claim: The company is on track to achieve its vision of becoming a one-stop solution for renewable energy in the solid, liquid, and gas segments.
guidance.quote: We are absolutely on track to fulfil our vision and mission in becoming a one-stop solution for renewable energy in the Solid, Liquid and Gas segments.

demand_outlook.claim: Management highlighted that there is a 14% blending mandate across Europe for using biodiesel.
demand_outlook.quote: If I talk about the European Union region, the demand is even higher as there is a 14% blending mandate across Europe for using biodiesel.

demand_outlook.claim: The company has recently received large-scale orders from government PSUs.
demand_outlook.quote: The recent large-scale orders from government PSUs, investments in capacity expansion, technological upgrades at biodiesel plants, along with our entry into the CBG and Pellets segment, collectively reaffirm our strategic roadmap toward becoming a comprehensive and integrated BioEnergy company.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has successfully enhanced capacity at the Phulera and Meerut units by almost 3-4 times.
capex_expansion.quote: We have successfully enhanced capacity at our Phulera and Meerut units by almost 3-4 times.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated they received approvals for establishing two compressed biogas units in Rajasthan.
capex_expansion.quote: As mentioned in our annual report also, for those who have missed the annual report or not gone through it, we have received approvals for establishing two compressed biogas units in the state of Rajasthan.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has expanded its operations into CBG and biomass pellets.

margins_costs.claim: Sourcing feedstock through Rajputana Agro LLP reduces input cost volatility and secures raw material availability for CBG plants.
margins_costs.quote: Provides a captive, integrated feedstock supply chain — reducing input cost volatility and securing raw material availability for CBG plants at Ajmer and Nagaur.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that EBITDA margins in the CBG sector are more than 55%-60%.
margins_costs.quote: But trust me, the EBITDA margins are more than 55%-60% in the CBG sector.

margins_costs.claim: Management mentioned that the unit economics in the GCC region yield a 12% to 15% margin on revenues.
margins_costs.quote: So, in terms of unit economics, there is almost a 12%, 15% margin you make on your revenues.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that by November end of the year, previous biodiesel allocations of approximately INR 100 crores would be completed.
orders_capacity.quote: By November end of this year, we would be completing our previous biodiesel allocations of approximately INR100 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: Management noted that the current OMC biodiesel tender has received the highest volume of biodiesel supply bids ever in the company's history.
orders_capacity.quote: I am very delighted to share that the current OMC's biodiesel tender for the period of November to March 2026 is out and really glad to share with you that we have bid the highest volume of biodiesel supply ever in our history.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has secured long-term supply contracts with oil marketing companies including HPCL, BPCL, and IOCL.
orders_capacity.quote: Long-term supply contracts with OMC's (HPCL, BPCL and IOCL)

orders_capacity.claim: The company acquired Nirvaanraj Energy Private Limited, which possesses an 80 KLPD capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: Acquisition of Nirvaanraj Energy Private Limited (80 KLPD capacity)

capital_allocation.claim: The company remains focused on creating long-term shareholder value through sustainable and scalable energy solutions.
capital_allocation.quote: We remain focused on creating long-term shareholder value through sustainable and scalable energy solutions.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that capital raised in the IPO was utilized for immediate working capital needs, technical upgradation, and capacity enhancement.
capital_allocation.quote: We successfully utilized the capital raised in our IPO for immediate working capital needs and technical upgradation along with capacity enhancement.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's strategic roadmap includes the deleveraging of its balance sheet.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that pricing sometimes becomes a point of discussion during policy reviews in the biodiesel sector.
risks_headwinds.quote: The only thing is that sometimes in the review of policy, pricing becomes a point of discussion.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that previous biodiesel allocations of approximately INR 100 crores would be completed by November end of the year.
management_commitments.quote: By November end of this year, we would be completing our previous biodiesel allocations of approximately INR100 crores.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that civil work for the compressed biogas project is expected to start by January end.
management_commitments.quote: By January end, we are looking to start the civil work of this compressed biogas project.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that civil work for the export unit tapping the European Union and GCC marine blending market will begin by January end.
management_commitments.quote: By January end, we will be beginning the civil work for this project also.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that enhanced capacities at Phulera and Meerut are expected to be commissioned by December end and January starting.
management_commitments.quote: I believe that by December end and January starting, we will be able to commission our enhanced capacities.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
